mechanism: Celecoxib inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing tolterodine metabolism inhibition and antimuscarinergic effects; NSAIDs increase renal retention risk with anticholinergics.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth); consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if adverse effects emerge; assess renal function periodically.
